rounding_policy: Prose figures may be rounded for readability if the stated figure is within 5% (relative) of the true value, or within 0.5 percentage points when the value is itself a percentage, AND the rounding does not change the sign, the direction of a change, a ranking, or which side of a stated threshold the value falls on. Words like 'about'/'roughly' are welcome but not required inside that band. A figure outside the band, or one that changes sign/direction/ranking, is a misstatement. Structured numeric output (the JSON) is NOT covered by this policy: it must meet each check's explicit tolerance.

reference_facts.meaning: months before Sep with a non-zero value (so it is NOT new in Sep)

rules.claim: Identifies Wholesale Accounts as a new revenue stream in Sep 2026 (about 12,000; zero or absent in prior months).
Describes Mystery Shopper Program as new, first appearing, or appearing for the first time in Sep 2026. (It was also 400 in Mar and Jun 2026. Saying it was zero in Aug, or rose 'from 0', is allowed.)

commentary:
- **Data quality, check first:** 'Total for Professional Services' in Mar 2026 states 2,225.00, but its detail rows sum to 2,200.00 (diff 25.00). The analysis uses the detail rows; the reviewer should decide which figure is right. The structure was also rebuilt in two places. 'Total Delivery' had no header, so it was grouped from Delivery Van Fuel and Courier: Same Day, which sum to it in every month. 'Charitable Donations' has no values and no total row, so it was treated as a blank account and the 4 rows after it were kept at the parent level.
- **Comparisons not available:** TTM and year-over-year comparisons aren't available because the export covers only 9 months (Jan–Sep 2026).
- **Revenue:** 81,300 in Sep 2026, the highest month in the export. That is +17.7% vs Aug 2026 (69,050) and +17.3% vs the prior 6-month average (69,292). It includes 12,000 from 'Wholesale Accounts', a new stream that is zero in every earlier month of the export; the reviewer should confirm whether it will recur. Among the existing streams, Bread Sales rose 1.9% to 49,200 and has risen every month. Pastry Sales fell 2.2% to 15,700 and has fallen every month (18,500 in Jan 2026). Catering Revenue was 3,800 (-5.0%), after 4,000 in Aug and 9,100 in Jul 2026.
- **Margin:** gross margin was 65.3% in Sep 2026, up from 59.6% in Aug (+5.7 pp). That is above the prior 6-month average of 60.6% and the top of the period's range (low: 56.8% in Mar 2026). COGS was 28,220, vs 27,930 in Aug.
- **Costs:** operating expenses were 31,570, +21.0% vs Aug (26,085). The main driver is Wages & Salaries: 21,000 vs 16,000 (+5,000, +31.2%), after 16,000 in every earlier month of the export. The reviewer should confirm whether this is a lasting change or a single-month item. Mystery Shopper Program (400) reads "from 0" vs Aug, but it was also 400 in Mar and Jun 2026. In this export it recurs every third month and is not a new line.
- **Profitability:** net income was 21,553, vs 15,077 in Aug (+43.0%), and was positive in all 9 months. The export has no non-operating items, so the as-exported and underlying figures are the same.
- **Cash:** Bank Accounts were 37,600 in Sep 2026: -1,800 vs Aug and -10,800 vs six months earlier (48,400). Net income was positive in every month, so the P&L doesn't explain the decline. Question for the reviewer: what drove it (e.g. owner draws, asset purchases, timing)?
- **Unmapped accounts:** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates (a credit line, (250) in Sep) matched no category rule and sit in Other Opex. The reviewer may want to extend the category map.
